criteria.description: A brand-new account (Google or email-code signup) receives exactly one welcome email with the thank-you, tutorial link, social links and Discord invite
A returning login never sends it; a duplicate send for the same account is deduped by the signup:{user_id}-derived Resend Idempotency-Key
A send failure or hung send does not fail or hold sign-in
Copy follows T7610 rules: ASCII/no em dashes, no 'reel', no automatic claims, no credit amounts

tests.red_reason: AssertionError: assert 0 == 1 (no Resend POST on new signup; red run in an isolated worktree at base e19899607). C3 guards pass on base too (no send = no failure path), so they are regression guards, not red/green.
